text:
ana: Quick accessibility review of the compact model rows + actions. Noting 3 small but recurring issues: focus loss on flyout close, low-contrast micro-actions, and screen reader doubling on the row toggle. Posting notes so we can triage.

liam: Thanks Ana. Short repro for the focus loss? I haven't seen it locally.

ana: Steps on staging: tab to list, ArrowDown to row, Enter to open details flyout, Esc to close. Expected focus on the same row. Observed: focus jumps to the top skip link or header sometimes. Happens more with keyboard speed.

priya: I can repro and also saw the Apply Filters button skipped when going from toolbar into the list via Tab.

liam: Sounds like two things: (1) we might not be restoring focus to the trigger on close, (2) there's an offscreen focusable element left in DOM.

liam: I'll add handleClose logic: set flyout aria-hidden=true, remove trap tabindex, then trigger.focus({preventScroll:true}). Also ensure the trigger keeps a stable id so focus can be restored.

devex-bot: Auto-a11y scan: 3 warnings on /models: chip text contrast fails (muted gray on dark bg), .action-icon has no accessible name, and duplicate aria-label found on toggle -> SR repeats.

ana: For the SR duplication, we have visible text "Details" and an inner icon with aria-label="open". NVDA reads "Details open button". We should remove aria-label when visible text exists or use aria-hidden on decorative icons.

liam: Agreed. I'll remove redundant aria-labels and make the icon aria-hidden when not necessary. I'll also convert the row toggle to a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls.

priya: After those changes I'll run NVDA + VoiceOver checks and a keyboard-only flow. My checklist: tab order, esc behavior, focus restore, SR announcement contents.

ana: Also small visual tweak: increase focus halo for small chips to 3px and test in dark theme. devex, can you pick token updates for chip-muted?

devex-bot: Noted. Suggest chip-muted light: #50565A and dark: #C4C7CA. Will run visual smoke after PR.

liam: I'll push a small PR with: focus restore, remove duplicate aria labels, icon aria-hidden, swap div-role=button to button, and focus halo CSS. Tagging @pri ya for validation.

ana: Thanks all. Once validated I'll paste acceptance checklist into the PR. Aim: predictable keyboard flows and no duplicated SR labels. :thumbsup:
